_comment: NON-RUNNABLE INSTALLATION TEMPLATE for Claude Code hooks (~/.claude/settings.json). deploy/register-members.py renders @HESTIA_PLUGIN_ROOT@/claude-code/hooks/<file> to the member's declared install dest (expects.json install.dest) and merges, by target basename, only the hooks the settings do not already carry. It renders @HESTIA_HOME@ to the deploying environment's HESTIA_HOME as an absolute path (unset refuses: the bootstrap locator has no default) on the gate and the witness, the two hooks that load the seat projection, together with HESTIA_ROLE="${HESTIA_ROLE:-@HESTIA_DEFAULT_ROLE@}": the role is launch context, never config (the projection cannot carry it), so the line passes a launcher's HESTIA_ROLE through and otherwise defaults to this member's install.default_role (no declaration drops the token). Since dp's 2026-10-06 ruling the deployer OWNS these lines: every line it installed is rewritten to this template on each deploy; per-seat customisation goes through the vault's seat projection, never a hand edit to a hook line. Unrendered placeholders must never be deployed. Shapes and timeouts mirror the registration measured on thor 2026-09-28.
_why: Before this file, claude-code's registration was a hand edit on every host (#1133, #1135): the plugin shipped pre_tool_use.py, witness.py and law_inject.py and nothing wrote them into settings.json. The daemon's install_claude_code merges only the witness. This template is what the installer renders.
_timeout_contract: One-gate stage C. The PreToolUse gate READS its timeout from the registration this template becomes (seconds; Claude Code's default for an entry without one is 60) and decides inside start + timeout - 1.5 s, so it always fails closed before Claude Code kills it (a hook timeout is a non-blocking error there: the tool runs, i.e. fail-open). 10 s absorbs one cold member connect (measured 4.6-5.1 s). A shorter registration costs availability, never safety; deploy/register-members.py reports one below this floor.
_disposition_reader: disposition_deliver.py (PRD_DISPOSITION_DELIVERY R4/R4a, #845, #849) renders the daemon's ruling on the asker's own hook stream, so an asker learns 'approved, re-issue the same act' without the operator relaying it in chat. PreToolUse and PostToolUse are the ports that reach a SUBAGENT (every tool call it makes fires them, carrying the parent's session_id plus its own agent_id, measured on Claude Code 2.1.290, 2026-10-06); UserPromptSubmit reaches only the interactive parent idle at its prompt. PreToolUse renders on the asker's very next call; PostToolUse catches a ruling that lands during a long call. It is a stat on one file and fails silent, so 3 s, the witness's budget. It carries HESTIA_HOME because the lane lives in the daemon's home, and no HESTIA_ROLE because it loads no seat projection. Before this entry the reader shipped in expects.json and no host registered it (CBP's deploy log: 'skip disposition_deliver.py - not registered on this host'), so every ruling still went by hand.
